gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Expressive and widely tracked, Offside leaves its curves open and hums along on a level beat. But Noto Sans Wancho does the heavy lifting in text, a sans-serif with chalk-thick lowercase and wide-gapped e terminals.
gen-gf-offside-gf-orienta: Offside tracks wide and draws every stroke like a rolling-ball pen. Orienta's counters breathe and its cases sit close in height, which leaves a hushed, modern restraint under the heading's swagger.
gen-gf-offside-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, with lowercase rising close to capitals. Under Offside's widely tracked, level headings it holds crisp and wide-mouthed, so the display type gets the swagger while the sans does the steady talking.
gen-gf-offside-gf-preahvihear: Offside tracks its letters wide, every stroke in the same gauge, curves left open. But Preahvihear's oyster-shell openings and a lofty x-height are what linger, with loud lettering above and generous lowercase below.
gen-gf-offside-gf-pt-sans-caption: Offside spreads wide and holds a single flat line weight through every glyph. Yet PT Sans Caption brings big-bodied lowercase and bowls left unclosed, so the strongest pull here is loud on top, welcoming below.
gen-gf-offside-gf-puritan: Commanding up top, Offside gives every stroke a pipe-like body and tracks out widely. But Puritan, a sans-serif of rounded forms and oversized e and a counters, is what keeps the pair friendly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-questrial: Questrial reads flat and stencil-cut, a sans-serif of single-weight strokes, short stalks sitting above a tall band of letters. Beside Offside's widely tracked display letters, that flatness becomes the quiet backbone.
gen-gf-offside-gf-radio-canada-big: Offside's wide tracking comes first, its letters spaced out on a level, quiet beat. Radio Canada Big carries paragraphs on a monoline skeleton, terminals well away from the stem, x-height filling the line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps broad gaps at its terminals and almost no gap between lowercase and caps. While Offside is made for declaring, wide and level, Readex Pro is built for carrying a steady weight from word to word.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-schibste: Ascenders that barely clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister a compact, outward-pointing swagger. And Schibsted Grotesk follows with big open-looking e and a shapes and terminals that never close in.
